detailed_descriptions.en: FOR THOSE WHO WANT MORE THAN ADVENTURE! Warlords IV is a unique blend of role-playing and turn-based strategy gaming. The game centers around your hero, who plays a pivotal role in the success or failure of your military and economic efforts. Warlords IV is set in the troubled land of Etheria. Old foes such as Dwarves, Elves and Orcs have resumed their ancient hostilities and the Undead legions of Lord Bane have returned. The Sirians continue their quest for dominance, and the unquiet whispers speak of the Volturnans, a race even more evil than the Undead. Now is the time for the races of Etheria to come together and engage in the final battle between Good and Evil. It is a time for Heroes! BACK ON MODERN SYSTEMS Originally released in 2003, Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria is a turn-based fantasy strategy game by Infinite Interactive, designed by series creator Steve Fawkner. The final mainline entry in the long-running Warlords series, it streamlined the formula into fast, tactical battles. Now available for the first time on Steam, it runs smoothly on modern systems and builds on the work of the Warlords community. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
FOR THOSE WHO WANT MORE THAN ADVENTURE!

Warlords IV is a unique blend of role-playing and turn-based strategy gaming. The game centers around your hero, who plays a pivotal role in the success or failure of your military and economic efforts.

Warlords IV is set in the troubled land of Etheria. Old foes such as Dwarves, Elves and Orcs have resumed their ancient hostilities and the Undead legions of Lord Bane have returned. The Sirians continue their quest for dominance, and the unquiet whispers speak of the Volturnans, a race even more evil than the Undead.

Now is the time for the races of Etheria to come together and engage in the final battle between Good and Evil. It is a time for Heroes!

BACK ON MODERN SYSTEMS

Originally released in 2003, Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria is a turn-based fantasy strategy game by Infinite Interactive, designed by series creator Steve Fawkner. The final mainline entry in the long-running Warlords series, it streamlined the formula into fast, tactical battles. Now available for the first time on Steam, it runs smoothly on modern systems and builds on the work of the Warlords community.

FEATURES

  • A tactical combat system that lets you watch the results of your armies in action

  • A strategic, non-linear campaign plus random maps and a wide variety of victory conditions deliver a game with great replay value

  • 10 races and 60 units for epic battle

  • Five spheres of magic to master

  • Thorough and resourceful AI at both strategic and tactical levels

ENHANCEMENTS

  • Runs smoothly on modern Windows systems

  • Plays in 16:9 borderless widescreen, with improved Alt+Tab behaviour

  • Supports modern resolutions, including 4K

  • Built on top of the community fixes from patch 1.05b

  • Includes the community-made Amthor campaign: ten bonus scenarios, shipped in the Extras folder

  • Ships with the community-made Warlord & Retinue Editor

  • Added Steam Cloud support and Steam Achievements
